description: List native object identities with reviewed mappings, page by page: the response carries total (every object matching the filter), nextCursor while more pages remain and the knowledge revision on each page. Follow nextCursor until it is null to collect the full list — walking every page covers exactly total objects, so completeness is provable; an invalid cursor is an explicit error, never a silent reset. A listed topic does not guarantee a current answer; use answer_lookup for current availability.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor: the exact nextCursor returned by the previous call. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Page size; default 100 (sized to fit common client response limits), maximum 250.

type.description: Filter by object type, e.g. state, program, regime, bank, legal_form.

name: answer_objects

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

provenance.description: Origin of one record: stable id, clean canonical URL, publisher, the exact published revision served, a ready citation, primary sources and review status.

id.description: <locale>:<slug> for an article, <dataset>:<record id> for a dataset row.

version.description: Revision of exactly the material served: for an article the snapshot content hash (the HTML ETag value); for a dataset record the dataset revision it was published in, not the published filename. Null when unknown.

total.description: Every object matching the type filter, across all pages.

title: List reviewed native topics
